item.name: Retrieve asteroids by closest approach date

request.name: Retrieve asteroids by closest approach date

description.content: Returns a list of asteroids based on their closest approach date to Earth within the specified date range. Maximum date range is 7 days.

query.description: (Required) Start date of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD format).
End date of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD format). Must be within 7 days of start_date. Defaults to 7 days after start_date if omitted.
NASA API key. Defaults to DEMO_KEY if omitted.

response.name: Successful response with asteroid feed data.
Bad request — date range exceeds 7 days or invalid date format.
Rate limit exceeded or invalid API key.

info.name: NASA NeoWs - Near Earth Object Web Service Browse Feed API

description.content:
NASA Near Earth Object Web Service (NeoWs) REST API for searching and browsing near Earth asteroid information. Users can search for asteroids based on their closest approach date to Earth, look up a specific asteroid by NASA JPL small body (SPK-ID), and browse the overall dataset. Data originates from the NASA JPL Asteroid team (http://neo.jpl.nasa.gov/). Maintained by the SpaceRocks Team: David Greenfield, Arezu Sarvestani, Jason English, and Peter Baunach.
